name: Tidal Observatory — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Sea-green stone observatory drum with arched lower facade and wave-edged balcony, giant gold/blue star clock, blue-bronze dome crossed by armillary-like gold rings, stairs and rocky tidal base. Hidden layout inference: A shore path/low bridge reaches a raised entrance deck, wraps along the wave balcony, then climbs to one sheltered viewing chamber or terrace. Keep clock facade facing arrival and retain open tidal views; nearby tide pools provide small discovery stops rather than a new city. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B21-STRUCT-001 — Tidal Observatory — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need curved wall/clock reveal host, balcony/stair return, dome/ring supports and rock-to-deck contacts. Clock/wave/metal ring vocabulary already present; rotating or illuminated behavior is separate optional work. Salt grasses/seaweed, seabirds/crabs/tide-pool fauna proposed; tide levels not solved. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
